free_parameters.name: batch_size
free_parameters.why: the witness fixes q_len/k_len only; one batch keeps the CPU run minimal and the guard reads only the sequence-length dimensions

free_parameters.name: head_dim
free_parameters.why: the witness does not fix head_dim; 16 is the smallest value accepted by the later head_dim guard and is irrelevant to the q_len == k_len assertion

free_parameters.name: num_q_heads
free_parameters.why: the witness does not fix the query head count; one head keeps the CPU tensors minimal and the length guard does not depend on it

free_parameters.name: num_kv_heads
free_parameters.why: the witness does not fix the kv head count; one kv head matches num_q_heads so the later GQA divisibility guard is satisfied

free_parameters.name: block_size
free_parameters.why: a valid block size from the repository's accepted set; it is checked only after the target length guard on the negative run

free_parameters.name: dtype
free_parameters.why: the function asserts q.dtype == torch.bfloat16 immediately before the target line, and bfloat16 tensors can be allocated on CPU

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixed seed makes tensor construction deterministic across repeat and replay runs

execution.entry_reason: The step-4 hand-off synthesises the chain as [flex_prefill_attention, target] without the real call graph. flex_prefill_attention cannot reach this target: for q_len == 1 it takes the flash-decoding branch, and for q_len > 1 it uses the separate block-wise FlexPrefill path. The real caller of the target is vertical_slash_attention, which is not in the chain and runs GPU-only index selection before the guard. Calling the target function directly (chain index 1) exercises the real guard on CPU without any pre-target GPU code.

mocks.reason: flash_attn is an optional GPU dependency that is not installed on this CPU host, while vertical_slash_attention imports it unconditionally at module load; the fake makes the real module importable and is never executed before the target
CPU attention implementation for the optional GPU flash-attention launcher; the target function does not call it before or at the q_len == k_len guard
